item.coloph: ces pa'i ma mo srid rgyal gyi lag len ni/ mkha' 'gro dbang mo/ spyang g.yung drung*/ g.yung drung dpal ldan/ ye shes bstan 'dzin/ bstan 'dzin ye shes/ tshul khrims rnam dag tshul khrims ye shes/ bstan pa dbang rgyal sogs mang pos srid rgyal drel nag gi sgrub skor phab dgos kyis yang yang bskur ngor/ gsang sngags gling pas phab cing yi ge pa ni rtogs ldan g.yung drung dpal bzang po'i bgyis pas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
